description: Allowlist for ADR-039 Forbidden-Dependency Guard. Entries here document permitted false positives or dev-only transitive dependencies explicitly authorized by specification decisions.

allowlist.justification: Specification §19.1 explicitly mandates Supertest for backend integration testing ('Vitest + Supertest + Testcontainers'). Supertest depends on superagent, which transitively includes formidable. It is strictly absent from production dependencies and runtime application code.
